en.title: Minimum Operations to Zero an Array by Assigning Range XOR
en.description:
The array has even length. One operation chooses any 0≤L≤R<n, computes the XOR x of all elements in the range before the operation, then sets every element in the range to x simultaneously. Find the minimum number of operations to make every element zero.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains an even n; the second line contains the array. The original text only specifies that n is even; this site uses 2≤n≤200000; 0≤element<2^20.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 0, 1 and 2. Third example: 1,2→3,3→0,0.
hints: Return 0 if every element is already zero; otherwise return 1 if the XOR of the whole array is 0, and 2 in all other cases.
